kind: current-phase two first-viewport screenshot paths rewritten by later cache regression
cause: Copied cache QA receipt path was unique, but its screenshot OUT remained the phase root, overlapping the initial refresh run. Receipt-only replay guard did not guard PNG paths.
limits: Initial exact PNG byte identities were not recorded before overwrite and cannot be compared or confirmed restored. This proves path/provenance loss, not that rendered pixels necessarily differ. No prior-stage receipt or pixels were targeted; prior1119 deliveryhashes will be reverified.
repair: New independent refresh QA in a fresh subdirectory with unique receipt; capture reserves destination with fs.open(wx) and writes screenshot buffer to that handle, rejecting existing paths. Initial receipts remain untouched and affected images are not used as initial-run visual proof.
